Name: Swizzy Meads
Author: SwizzyStudios
Description:
[size=4]Breakdown[/size]
[size=4]This mod adds the ability to create different flavored meads.  By default all Honey types turn into simple mead but with this mod each honey type will become its own special flavor![/size]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/wAFAjBV.png[/img]

[size=4]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.3.36
[*]Works fine in single-player.
[*]Works fine in multiplayer but to be able to create the new flavors of mead each player needs to have this downloaded.  Others who do not will just get mead. Interacting with the new mead will not crash players who do not have this mod.
[*][b]This mod is compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url]﻿ however automating Kegs with honey will still produce regular Mead.  Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3260]Swizzy's Distillery (CFR)[/url]﻿ in place of this mod to work with Automate.[/b]
[*]This mod alters the base code of Stardew Valley via [url=https://github.com/pardeike/Harmony]Harmony[/url]﻿. [i] [/i]
[/list][i] ﻿This may conflict with other mods that also alter base code specifically around the Object.[/i]performObjectDropInAction method.

Manifest.Description: This Mod will add in more variety of Meads. Tulip Mead, Blue Jazz Mead, Summer Spangle Mead, Poppy Mead, Fairy Rose Mead.  The process is the same as existing and the mead value will be 2x of the base sell price.
